tie_break: Recall@10, smaller dimensions, earlier epochs, smaller alpha
feature_encoding: Independent user and movie ID embeddings; identity matrices with unit row mass
statistics_protocol: No statistical features. Parameter-fitting suffix labels match the controlled feature experiment; prefix rows are unused.
representation_constraint: Each user/movie has an independent ID embedding; no attribute or historical-statistic features
training_feedback: Train rating >= relevance_threshold: +1; rating 1/2: -1; rating 3 and unknown omitted
negative_sampling: None: only observed training ratings; no validation/test labels consulted
history_use: Fixed training user vectors; stage history filters candidates, no online vector update
candidate_protocol: Shared full unseen training catalog and eligible users; no sampled evaluation negatives
metric_aggregation: macro-average over eligible users; warm relevant targets
early_stopping: Choose among requested epoch checkpoints by validation NDCG@10
configuration_selection: Validation NDCG@10, then Recall@10; test evaluated after freezing configurations
